title: New Language of Resistance: An Evening of Poetry

images.alt_text: New Language of Resistance: An Evening of Poetry

description:
Part of the 18th edition of Jawani Ka Josh's October Jam, this evening at Maraa brings together young poets reading work centred on resistance. Moderated by Dadapeer Jyman, the line-up includes Saviraj Anaduru, Nadeem Sanadi, Vishal Myasar, Sreendi Prahlad, Dilip Shivgauri, Chand Pasha, Hajira Khanam and Siddartha M S, among others.

The format is open: come to listen, or bring a poem of your own to share. All are welcome.
short_description: Young poets read verse of resistance in an open evening at Maraa, moderated by Dadapeer Jyman, with the floor open to anyone who brings their own.
